mapper.sql: h.SHIP_INSTRUCTION_ID, h.SHIP_INSTRUCTION_NO, TO_CHAR(h.BUSINESS_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS BUSINESS_DATE, h.PARTNER_ID, p.PARTNER_CODE, h.PARTNER_NAME, h.WAREHOUSE_ID, w.WAREHOUSE_CODE, h.WAREHOUSE_NAME, h.ASSIGNEE_ID, a.ASSIGNEE_CODE, h.ASSIGNEE_NAME, h.NOTE, TO_CHAR(h.PLANNED_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS PLANNED_DATE, h.DELIVERY_CONTACT, h.DELIVERY_POSTAL_CODE, h.DELIVERY_ADDRESS, h.PROGRESS_STATUS, h.DELETED_YN, TO_CHAR(h.UPDATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS UPDATED_AT
FROM SHIP_INSTRUCTION h LEFT JOIN BIZ_PARTNER p ON p.PARTNER_ID = h.PARTNER_ID LEFT JOIN WAREHOUSE w ON w.WAREHOUSE_ID = h.WAREHOUSE_ID LEFT JOIN ASSIGNEE a ON a.ASSIGNEE_ID = h.ASSIGNEE_ID
mapper.select: SELECT l.SHIP_INSTRUCTION_LINE_ID, l.SHIP_INSTRUCTION_ID, l.SALE_LINE_ID, l.ITEM_ID, i.ITEM_CODE, l.ITEM_NAME, l.SPECIFICATION, l.UNIT, l.QUANTITY, l.NOTE, l.DELETED_YN FROM SHIP_INSTRUCTION_LINE l JOIN SHIP_INSTRUCTION h ON h.SHIP_INSTRUCTION_ID = l.SHIP_INSTRUCTION_ID LEFT JOIN ITEM i ON i.ITEM_ID = l.ITEM_ID WHERE l.SHIP_INSTRUCTION_ID = #{shipInstructionId} AND l.DELETED_YN = 'N' AND h.DELETED_YN = 'N' ORDER BY l.SHIP_INSTRUCTION_LINE_ID ASC

INSERT INTO SHIP_INSTRUCTION ( SHIP_INSTRUCTION_ID, SHIP_INSTRUCTION_NO, BUSINESS_DATE, PARTNER_ID, PARTNER_NAME, WAREHOUSE_ID, WAREHOUSE_NAME, ASSIGNEE_ID, ASSIGNEE_NAME, NOTE, PLANNED_DATE, DELIVERY_CONTACT, DELIVERY_POSTAL_CODE, DELIVERY_ADDRESS, PROGRESS_STATUS, UPDATED_AT, DELETED_YN ) VALUES ( #{shipInstructionId}, LPAD(TO_CHAR(#{shipInstructionId}), GREATEST(5,LENGTH(TO_CHAR(#{shipInstructionId}))), '0'), TO_DATE(#{businessDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), #{partnerId}, #{partnerName}, #{warehouseId}, #{warehouseName}, #{assigneeId}, #{assigneeName}, #{note}, TO_DATE(#{plannedDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), #{deliveryContact}, #{deliveryPostalCode}, #{deliveryAddress}, 'IN_PROGRESS', LOCALTIMESTAMP, 'N' )
mapper.update: UPDATE SHIP_INSTRUCTION SET BUSINESS_DATE = TO_DATE(#{businessDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), PARTNER_ID = #{partnerId}, PARTNER_NAME = #{partnerName}, WAREHOUSE_ID = #{warehouseId}, WAREHOUSE_NAME = #{warehouseName}, ASSIGNEE_ID = #{assigneeId}, ASSIGNEE_NAME = #{assigneeName}, NOTE = #{note}, PLANNED_DATE = TO_DATE(#{plannedDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), DELIVERY_CONTACT = #{deliveryContact}, DELIVERY_POSTAL_CODE = #{deliveryPostalCode}, DELIVERY_ADDRESS = #{deliveryAddress}, UPDATED_AT = LOCALTIMESTAMP WHERE SHIP_INSTRUCTION_ID = #{shipInstructionId} AND DELETED_YN = 'N'
